items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: Joe Venudo became kind of a star in the band

ctx.x: That was true of Moussey and Nick and I kept replacing them. Harvey Estrom had to go too.
Joe Venudo became kind of a star in the band, didn't he? He was featured on a lot of different percussion.
Yes, he was a very electric sort of person. I guess he did very well as a percussionist after that.
